book.name: Mɑteu
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Yesu u durɔ ɡoo bɛkiɑ
wìn wɑsin bee tiɑ ɡu
Yesu u ɡoo nimkuu duɑ mɑ u wure u dɑɑ bure te tɔburɑ, mɑ u turɑ win tiin wuuɔ.
Tɔmbu ɡɑbu bɑ kɑ nùn durɔ ɡoo nɑɑwɑ wìn wɑsin bee tiɑ yɑ ɡu. Durɔ wi, u kpĩ kpinu wɔllɔ. Ye Yesu u ben nɑɑnɛ dokebu wɑ, u bɑrɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bii durɔbu, ɑ ku mwiɑ kpɑnɑ, ɑ wunɛn durum suuru wɑ.
Mɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu ɡɑbɑ bwisikɑ bɑ tii sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, durɔ wini u Gusunɔ wɔmmɔwɑ.
Yesu u yɛ̃ ye bɑ bwisikumɔ mɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i kɔ̃sɑ bwisikumɔ bɛɛn ɡɔ̃ruɔ.
Yerɑ̀ yɑ sɛ̃sɔ bo, n tɔnu sɔ̃ u win durum suuru wɑ, ǹ kun mɛ n nùn sɔ̃ u seewo u sĩ.
Nɑ kĩ i n yɛ̃ mɑ Tɔnun Bii u yiiko mɔ hɑnduniɑ sɔɔ u kɑ tɔnun durum suuru ko. Yen sɔ̃nɑ u bɑrɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ seewo ɑ wunɛn kpinu suɑ kpɑ ɑ we yɛnuɔ.
Durɔ wi, u seewɑ mɑ u sĩɑ win yɛnuɔ.
Ye tɔn be, bɑ yeni wɑ bɛrum bu mwɑ mɑ bɑ Gusunɔ siɑrɑ yèn sɔ̃ u yiiko yen bweseru tɔnu wɛ̃.
Yesu u Mɑteu sokɑ
Yesu u doonɑ min di. Ye u sĩimɔ swɑɑɔ u ɡbere mwɑɔ ɡoo wɑ wi bɑ rɑ soku Mɑteu u sɔ̃ ɡbere yerɔ. Mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑn swĩiyɔ. Mɑ Mɑteu u seewɑ u nùn swĩi.
Ye Yesu u dimɔ durɔ win yɛnuɔ, ɡbere mwɑɔbu kɑ kɔ̃sɑn kowobu dɑbinu bɑ nɑ bɑ sinɑ kɑ Yesu kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɑnnu.
Fɑlisi ɡɑbɑ wɑ mɛ, mɑ bɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ bɛɛn yinni u dimɔ kɑ ɡbere mwɑɔbu kɑ kɔ̃sɑn kowobu.
Yesu u ben ɡɑri yi nuɑ mɑ u nɛɛ, be bɑ bwɑ̃ɑ do bɑ ǹ timɡiin bukɑtɑ mɔ mɑ n kun mɔ be bɑ bɑrɔ.
I doo i Gusunɔn ɡɑrin tubusiɑnu kɑsu yi yi nɛɛ, “Wɔnwɔndɑ nɑ kĩ, n ǹ mɔ yɑ̃kuru.” Domi nɑ ǹ nɛ n kɑ ɡeeɡibu soku mɑ n kun mɔ torobu.
Nɔɔ bɔkurun ɡɑri
Mɑ Yohɑnu Bɑtɛmu kowon bwɑ̃ɑbɑ nɑ Yesun mi bɑ bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ bɛsɛ kɑ Fɑlisibɑ sɑ rɑ nɔɔ bɔke, ɑdɑmɑ wunɛ, wunɛn bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ ku rɑ nɔɔ bɔke.

Yesu u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, be bɑ sokɑ kurɔ kpɑɑ yerɔ bɑ ko n nukuru sɑnkire sɑnɑm mɛ kurɔ kpɑon durɔ wɑ̃ɑ ben suunu sɔɔ? Aɑwo, ɑdɑmɑ sɑɑ yɑ sisi yè sɔɔ bɑ koo kurɔ kpɑon durɔ wɔrɑ ben min di. Sɑɑ yerɑ bɑ koo nɔɔ bɔke.
Goo ku rɑ yɑ̃ɑ tɔkɔnu kɔre kɑ yɑsi kpɑɑ ye bɑ ǹ nim doke. Ù n kuɑ mɛ, yɑsi kpɑɑ ye, yɑ koo ɡɑwɑnɑ kpɑ yu yɑ̃ɑ tɔkɔ ni ɡĩɑm sosi.

Goo ku rɑ mɑɑ tɑm kpɑm doke ɡɔnɑn bɔɔ tɔkɔnu sɔɔ. Ù n kuɑ mɛ, bɔɔ ni, nu koo kurɑ kpɑ tɑm mɛ, mu yɑri kpɑ bɔɔnu nu sɑnkirɑ. Adɑmɑ bɑ rɑ tɑm kpɑm wisiwɑ ɡɔnɑn bɔɔ kpɑɑnu sɔɔ. Sɑnɑm mɛ, ye yiru yen ɡɑɑ kun sɑnkirɑmɔ.
Wiruɡii ɡoon bii kɑ kurɔ wi u Yesun yɑberu bɑbɑn ɡɑri
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yesu u bu yeni sɔ̃ɔmɔ wiruɡii ɡoo u nɑ u yiirɑ win wuswɑɑɔ u nɛɛ, nɛn bii tɔn kurɔ u ɡu tɛ̃, ɑdɑmɑ ɑ nɑ ɑ nùn nɔmu sɔndi kpɑ u se.
Mɑ Yesu u seewɑ kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ durɔ wi swĩi.
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ dɔɔ, kurɔ ɡoo wi u yɛm wĩibu bɑrɔ sɑɑ wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ yirun di, u susi Yesun biruɔ u win yɑberun swɑɑ buɑ bɑbɑ.
U ɡeruɑ win tiin ɡɔ̃ruɔ u nɛɛ, ù n ɡesi win yɑberu bɑbɑ u koo bɛkurɑ.
Yesu u sĩirɑ u nùn wɑ mɑ u nɛɛ, kurɔ wunɛ, ɑ ku mwiɑ kpɑnɑ, wunɛn nɑɑnɛ dokebu nun bɛkiɑ. Yɑnde mɑ kurɔ wi, u bɛkurɑ.
Ye Yesu u turɑ wiruɡii win dirɔ, yerɑ u deemɑ ɡɑbɑ ɡuunu soomɔ mɑ be kpuro bɑ sirenɛ.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, i yɑrio bɛɛ kpuro, wɔndiɑ wi kun ɡu, u dowɑ. Mɑ be kpuro bɑ nùn yɑɑkoru wɔri.
Ye bɑ tɔmbu yɑrɑ bɑ kpɑ Yesu u duɑ u wɔndiɑ win nɔmu nɛnuɑ, mɑ wɔndiɑ wi, u seewɑ.
Yenin lɑbɑɑri yɑ kpɑrɑrɑwɑ tem mɛ kpuro sɔɔ.
Yesu u wɔ̃kobu yiru bɛkiɑ
Yesu u doonɑ min di. Nɡe mɛ u win sɑnum dɔɔ, wɔ̃kobu yiru ɡɑbɑ nùn swĩi. Bɑ nɔɔɡiru sue bɑ mɔ̀, Dɑfidin sikɑdobu, ɑ bɛsɛn wɔnwɔndu wɑɑwo.
Ye Yesu u duɑ dirɔ wɔ̃ko be, bɑ nɑ win mi, mɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, i nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ mɑ kon kpĩ n yeni ko? Mɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mɛyɑ Yinni.
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ Yesu ben nɔni bɑbɑ mɑ u nɛɛ, n bɛɛ kooro nɡe mɛ i nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ.
Mɑ bɑ yɑm wɑ. Yerɑ Yesu u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u sire u nɛɛ, bu ku rɑɑ ɡoo yeni sɔ̃.
Adɑmɑ ye bɑ doonɑ min di kese bɑ win lɑbɑɑri kpɑrɑm wɔri tem mɛ kpuro sɔɔ.
Yesu u soso bɛkiɑ
Ye tɔn be, bɑ doonɑ mɑ ɡɑbɑ kɑ durɔ ɡoo nɑ Yesun mi, wi u sɑ̃ɑ soso yèn sɔ̃ u wɛrɛku ɡɑɡu mɔ win wɑsi sɔɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yesu u wɛrɛku ɡe ɡirɑ durɔ wi, u ɡɑri ɡerubu wɔri. Mɑ tɔmbɑ biti kuɑ mɑ bɑ nɛɛ, sɑ ǹ yenin bweseru wɑɑre Isireli sɔɔ.
Adɑmɑ Fɑlisibɑ nɛɛ, wɛrɛkunun wiruɡiiwɑ u nùn dɑm wɛ̃ u kɑ nu ɡirɑ.
Yesu u tɔmbu wɔnwɔndu kuɑ
Yesu u bɔsu wuu mɑrosu kpuro sɔɔ kɑ bɑru kpɑɑnɔ. U keu sɔ̃ɔsimɔ ben mɛnnɔ yenɔ u Gusunɔn bɑndun Lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑ kpɑrɑmɔ, mɑ u tɔmbu bɛkiɑmɔ sɑɑ bɑrɑru kɑ wɑsin dɑm sɑriru bwese bwesekɑn di.
Ye u tɔn wɔrusu wɑ ben wɔnwɔndɑ nùn mwɑ yèn sɔ̃ bɑ wurure mɑ bɑ yɑrinɛ nɡe yɑ̃ɑ ni nu kun kpɑro mɔ.
Mɑ u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ye yɑ ye bu kɑ ɡɛ̃ yɑ kpɑ̃, ɑdɑmɑ be bɑ ɡɛ̃ɛmɔ bɑ ǹ dɑbi.
Yen sɔ̃, i ɡbee yɛ̃ro kɑnɔ u kpɑm tɔmbu mɔrisiɑmɑ bu kɑ ɡɛ̃.
